name: Disneyland Hotel Goofy's Kitchen Character Buffet: Carved Prime Rib, Turkey, Mickey Waffles & Smooth PB&J Pizza
whyItWorks: Goofy's Kitchen has a dedicated omelet station, carving station (prime rib, roasted turkey breast, salmon), plain pasta, mashed potatoes, Mickey waffles, and even Goofy's famous creamy Peanut Butter & Seedless Grape Jelly Pizza.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Build your plate from the omelet bar (plain eggs or ham & cheddar), carving station, mashed potatoes, bananas, and allergy-friendly Mickey waffles.
watchOuts: Skip raw salad bar items, bacon-wrapped jalapeños, and soft-serve toppings with nuts/seeds
